name: Axis Real Estate Investment Trust
overview: 2026年，Axis-REIT 继续通过收购工业物业扩大其投资组合，完成了对 Shah Alam、Bandar Saujana Putra、Bandar Sultan Suleiman 工业物业的收购，并签署了收购 Pulau Indah 工业用地及物业、Kedah 工业综合体的协议；同时，一项拟收购 Penang 物业的提议因尽职调查结果不理想而终止。
overview_en: In 2026, Axis-REIT continued to expand its portfolio through acquisitions of industrial properties, completing the acquisitions of industrial properties in Shah Alam, Bandar Saujana Putra, and Bandar Sultan Suleiman, and entering into agreements to acquire industrial land and premises in Pulau Indah and an industrial complex in Kedah; meanwhile, a proposed acquisition in Penang was terminated due to unsatisfactory due diligence findings.

segments.name: 工业物业投资
segments.note: 今年继续收购工业物业以扩大投资组合，并终止了一项收购提议。
segments.note_en: Continued to acquire industrial properties to expand the portfolio this year, and terminated one proposed acquisition.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购位于 Shah Alam, Selangor 的 Seksyen 16 的工业物业，卖方为 Rubicon Assets Sdn. Bhd.。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of an industrial property located within Seksyen 16, Shah Alam, Selangor from Rubicon Assets Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购位于 Bandar Saujana Putra, Selangor 的配送中心，卖方为 City-Link Express (M) Sdn. Bhd.。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of a distribution centre within Bandar Saujana Putra, Selangor from City-Link Express (M) Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订买卖协议，拟收购位于 Taman Perindustrian Pulau Indah, Selangor 的3块相邻工业用地及已建工业物业，卖方为 Megalift Sdn. Bhd.。
actions.text_en: Entered into a sale and purchase agreement to acquire 3 adjoining parcels of industrial land erected with industrial premises within Taman Perindustrian Pulau Indah, Selangor from Megalift Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订买卖协议，拟收购位于 Kawasan Industri Padang Meha, Kedah 的工业综合体，卖方为 WH Union Development Sdn. Bhd.。
actions.text_en: Entered into a sale and purchase agreement to acquire an industrial complex within Kawasan Industri Padang Meha, Kedah from WH Union Development Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订买卖协议，拟收购位于 Bandar Saujana Putra, Selangor 的配送中心，卖方为 City-Link Express (M) Sdn. Bhd.。
actions.text_en: Entered into a sale and purchase agreement to acquire a distribution centre within Bandar Saujana Putra, Selangor from City-Link Express (M) Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 签订买卖协议，拟收购位于 Shah Alam, Selangor 的 Seksyen 16 的工业物业，卖方为 Rubicon Assets Sdn. Bhd.。
actions.text_en: Entered into a sale and purchase agreement to acquire an industrial property located within Seksyen 16, Shah Alam, Selangor from Rubicon Assets Sdn. Bhd.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 由于尽职调查结果不理想，终止拟收购位于 Seberang Perai Tengah, Penang 的永久地契物业的提议，卖方为 Ann Joo Steel Berhad。
actions.text_en: Terminated the proposed acquisition of a freehold property located within Seberang Perai Tengah, Penang from Ann Joo Steel Berhad due to unsatisfactory due diligence findings.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购位于 Kawasan Industri Bandar Sultan Suleiman, Selangor 的工业物业，卖方为 Barry Callebaut Malaysia Sdn. Bhd.。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of an industrial property located within Kawasan Industri Bandar Sultan Suleiman, Selangor from Barry Callebaut Malaysia Sdn. Bhd.
